segments.source: Oru auzi alarma de incendiu și se târî prin canal. Veyrina îi făcea membrele grele. Găsi prima grilă, o rupse și căzu în camera copiilor. Îi ridică pe rând, împingându-i spre tunelul deschis. Un adult ar fi putut transporta doi. El transportă trei, reveni, apoi patru mici deodată, legați de corp cu propria mantie.
segments.translation: Oru heard the fire alarm and crawled through the duct. The veyrin made his limbs heavy. He found the first grille, tore it off and fell into the children's chamber. He lifted them one by one, pushing them towards the open tunnel. An adult could have carried two. He carried three, returned, then four small ones at once, tied to his body with his own cloak.

segments.source: La ultima întoarcere, Nemi încă nu ieșise.
segments.translation: On his last return, Nemi had still not come out.

segments.source: O găsi sub conducta care ardea, privind flacăra cu o curiozitate sedată. O luă în brațe. Izolația se desprinse de plafon.
segments.translation: He found her beneath the burning pipe, watching the flame with sedated curiosity. He took her in his arms. The insulation came away from the ceiling.

segments.source: Când Taren ajunse, focul fusese stins, dar o parte din cameră se prăbușise. Scoase șapte copii. Al optulea era Nemi. Oru o ținea sub el, protejată de piatra care îi zdrobise spatele.
segments.translation: When Taren arrived, the fire was out, but part of the chamber had collapsed. He pulled out seven children. The eighth was Nemi. Oru held her beneath him, protected from the stone that had crushed his back.

segments.source: Era încă viu.
segments.translation: He was still alive.

segments.source: Sava veni alergând, cu masca atârnându-i de gât. Căzu lângă el și încercă să ridice placa. Taren o prinse înainte să-și rupă mâinile.
segments.translation: Sava came running, her mask hanging round her neck. She fell beside him and tried to lift the slab. Taren caught her before she broke her hands.

segments.source: — Avem nevoie de cric, spuse ea. Oru, rămâi treaz. Vessa vine.
segments.translation: “We need a jack,” she said. “Oru, stay awake. Vessa's coming.”

segments.source: Oru clipi încet. Sângele îi ieșea prin nări.
segments.translation: Oru blinked slowly. Blood came from his nostrils.

segments.source: — Nemi?
segments.translation: “Nemi?”

segments.source: — Trăiește. Este aici.
segments.translation: “She's alive. She's here.”

segments.source: Fetița se lipi de umărul lui, plângând fără sunet.
segments.translation: The little girl pressed against his shoulder, crying without a sound.

segments.source: — Clapetele, șopti Oru.
segments.translation: “The dampers,” Oru whispered.

segments.source: — Sunt deschise.
segments.translation: “They're open.”

segments.source: — Bine.
segments.translation: “Good.”

segments.source: — Nu vorbi.
segments.translation: “Don't talk.”

segments.source: — Ai avut dreptate.
segments.translation: “You were right.”

segments.source: Sava își apropie fruntea de a lui.
segments.translation: Sava brought her forehead close to his.

segments.source: — Despre ce?
segments.translation: “About what?”

segments.source: — Soluțiile.
segments.translation: “Solutions.”

segments.source: Respirația îi deveni neregulată.
segments.translation: His breathing grew irregular.

segments.source: — Nu le da morților motive pe care nu le-au avut, spuse. N-am murit pentru Vaor. Nici pentru Taren. Am vrut să scot copilul nostru de aici.
segments.translation: “Don't give the dead reasons they didn't have,” he said. “I didn't die for Vaor. Or for Taren. I wanted to get our child out of here.”

segments.source: Vessa sosi cu instrumentele. Privi poziția plăcii, culoarea mucoaselor lui Oru și cantitatea de sânge. Nu minți.
segments.translation: Vessa arrived with her instruments. She looked at the position of the slab, the colour of Oru's mucous membranes and the amount of blood. She did not lie.

segments.source: — Îl pot seda.
segments.translation: “I can sedate him.”

segments.source: Sava scoase un sunet jos, ancestral. Nu era plâns încă. Era corpul care afla înaintea minții.
segments.translation: Sava made a low, ancestral sound. It was not crying yet. It was the body learning before the mind.

segments.source: — Nu, spuse Oru. Destulă liniște.
segments.translation: “No,” Oru said. “Enough quiet.”

segments.source: Când placa se prăbuși peste Oru, conducta de aer se deschise complet și trase fumul în sus. Pentru câteva secunde, camera copiilor deveni limpede. Nemi își amintea mai târziu lumina aceea: roșie, tremurată, cu particule de cenușă urcând spre grilă. Tatăl ei era deasupra ei, iar spatele lui nu mai avea forma corectă.
segments.translation: When the slab fell onto Oru, the air duct opened fully and drew the smoke upwards. For a few seconds, the children's chamber became clear. Later, Nemi remembered that light: red, trembling, with particles of ash rising towards the grille. Her father was above her, and his back no longer had the right shape.

segments.source: — Nu mă lăsa, îi spuse.
segments.translation: “Don't leave me,” she told him.

segments.source: — Nu plec, răspunse Oru.
segments.translation: “I'm not leaving,” Oru replied.

segments.source: Nu era promisiune despre viață. Era una despre ultimele clipe. Nemi nu înțelese diferența.
segments.translation: It was not a promise about life. It was one about the last moments. Nemi did not understand the difference.

segments.source: După ce muri, Sava rămase lângă corp până când Vessa îi închise ochii. Taren scoase Nemi din cameră. Fetița îl mușcă de braț și se zbătu să revină.
segments.translation: After he died, Sava stayed beside the body until Vessa closed his eyes. Taren took Nemi out of the chamber. The little girl bit his arm and struggled to go back.

segments.source: — A spus că nu pleacă!
segments.translation: “He said he wasn't leaving!”

segments.source: — Știu.
segments.translation: “I know.”

segments.source: — Atunci ridică piatra!
segments.translation: “Then lift the stone!”

segments.source: Taren o ținu în timp ce ea lovea, zgâria și striga. Corpul copilului voia să fugă de moarte și spre ea în același timp. Nu exista exercițiu pentru asta.
segments.translation: Taren held her while she hit, scratched and screamed. The child's body wanted to run from death and towards it at the same time. There was no exercise for that.

segments.source: Până la sfârșitul zilei, numărul morților ajunse la o sută șase. Douăzeci și opt erau agenți centrali. Treisprezece aparțineau Primei Fețe. Restul erau locuitori, majoritatea striviți, sufocați sau surprinși de incendiu în timp ce veyrina le suspendase reflexele.
segments.translation: By the end of the day, the death toll had reached a hundred and six. Twenty-eight were central agents. Thirteen belonged to the First Face. The rest were inhabitants, most crushed, suffocated or caught in the fire while veyrin suspended their reflexes.

segments.source: Daran apăru pe toate canalele Vaorului și numi evenimentul Masacrul Ceții. Arătă trupurile copiilor. Arătă agenții centrali înarmați. Nu arătă primul membru al Primei Fețe care ucisese un adversar căzut.
segments.translation: Daran appeared on every Vaor channel and called the event the Mist Massacre. He showed the children's bodies. He showed the armed central agents. He did not show the first First Face member who had killed a fallen opponent.

segments.source: Seln Aru răspunse că un dispozitiv nonletal fusese sabotat de insurgenți și că morțile erau consecința rezistenței armate. Nu arătă ordinul de a aduce două tone de aerosol într-o stație aglomerată.
segments.translation: Seln Aru replied that a non-lethal device had been sabotaged by insurgents and that the deaths were the consequence of armed resistance. He did not show the order to bring two tonnes of aerosol into a crowded station.

segments.source: Adevărul fu împărțit atât de precis încât fiecare parte primi exact cantitatea necesară pentru ură.
segments.translation: Truth was divided so precisely that each side received exactly the amount it needed for hatred.

segments.source: La ceremonia pentru Oru, Sava refuză steagul Casei Veyr. Refuză și panglica albă trimisă de Camera Măsurii. Îl îngropară în stratul fertil de sub o cultură nouă, după obiceiul inginerilor radiculari.
segments.translation: At Oru's ceremony, Sava refused House Veyr's flag. She also refused the white ribbon sent by the Chamber of Measure. They buried him in the fertile layer beneath a new crop, according to the root engineers' custom.

segments.source: Taren stătu departe. Când ceremonia se termină, Sava veni la el.
segments.translation: Taren stood apart. When the ceremony ended, Sava came to him.

segments.source: — Daran va folosi moartea lui, spuse.
segments.translation: “Daran will use his death,” she said.

segments.source: — Știu.
segments.translation: “I know.”

segments.source: — Seln o va folosi.
segments.translation: “Seln will use it.”

segments.source: — Știu.
segments.translation: “I know.”

segments.source: — Tu o vei folosi?
segments.translation: “Will you use it?”

segments.source: Taren privi pământul proaspăt.
segments.translation: Taren looked at the fresh earth.

segments.source: — Nu pot promite că nu.
segments.translation: “I can't promise I won't.”

segments.source: Sava îl lovi. Palma îi despică buza.
segments.translation: Sava struck him. Her palm split his lip.

segments.source: Taren nu se apăra.
segments.translation: Taren did not defend himself.

segments.source: — Atunci măcar nu-i spune curaj, spuse ea.
segments.translation: “Then at least don't call it courage,” she said.

segments.source: În noaptea aceea, Prima Față își scrise primul cod pe peretele stației: nu se ucide după predare; nu se urmărește cel care fuge; hrana păzită nu aparține paznicului; copiii nu poartă semnul; ordinul care cere moartea celor neînarmați nu este ordin.
segments.translation: That night, the First Face wrote its first code on the station wall: no killing after surrender; no pursuing those who flee; guarded food does not belong to the guard; children do not wear the sign; an order demanding the death of the unarmed is not an order.

segments.source: Sub cele cinci reguli, cineva adăugă cu sânge uscat:
segments.translation: Beneath the five rules, someone added in dried blood:

segments.source: PACEA A TRAS PRIMA.
segments.translation: PEACE FIRED FIRST.

segments.source: Taren șterse propoziția.
segments.translation: Taren erased the sentence.
